Author: Kyuuso
Name: Eureka Suite
Punchline: All-in-one Eureka suite: aggro radars, live tracker sync, bunny helpers and Logos & Loot errands.
Description: All-in-one quality-of-life suite for Eureka (Anemos, Pagos, Pyros, Hydatos). Features lethal aggro radar visualizers (sleeping dragon sound aggro, low HP blood aggro, sprite magic aggro, vision cones, combat cast alerts), real-time ffxiv-eureka.com Phoenix WebSocket tracker synchronization, bunny FATE timer and coffer markers, and Logos & Loot errands. Bunny FATE automation is unlocked by a privately granted access package.
TestingChangelog: 2.9.9: Report a problem: the .log file now starts with a Now section (zone, position, job, and WigglyQuest's quest and step) and also keeps WigglyQuest's lines and the warnings of other plugins. A line that repeats within a minute is counted instead of written again.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Bozja Suite
Punchline: Save the Queen field operations helper: critical engagement tracker, fragment planner with market prices.
Description: Early beta. Quality-of-life suite for the Bozjan Southern Front and Zadnor. Tracks critical engagements and skirmishes with enlistment alerts, shows your Resistance rank and mettle, lists the forgotten fragments you carry and plans which fragments to farm or buy for the Lost Action you want, with Universalis prices. Field automation (skirmishes, critical engagements, Castrum Lacus Litore and the Dalriada through BossMod Reborn and Rotation Solver) is unlocked by a privately granted access package.
TestingChangelog: 0.5.11: Report a problem: the .log file now starts with a Now section (zone, position, job, and WigglyQuest's quest and step) and also keeps WigglyQuest's lines and the warnings of other plugins. A line that repeats within a minute is counted instead of written again.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Zodiac Helper
Punchline: Companion for ZodiacBuddy Reborn: automates the Novus, Nexus, Zodiac and Zeta steps of the ARR relics.
Description: Early beta. Helper for the ARR Zodiac relic line that works next to ZodiacBuddy Reborn. Infuses the materia you hold into your Sphere Scrolls, hands your relics to Jalzahn for each upgrade, and farms Light and Mahatmas through AutoDuty, with Remon attaching the next Mahatma. Optional: AutoDuty for the farms, vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs, Lifestream for inn rooms.
TestingChangelog:
0.9.0, first stable release since 0.1.0. ZodiacHelper now takes the A Realm Reborn relic of your job from A Relic Reborn to Zeta, and optionally through Kettle to the Mettle, from one Start button on the Main tab.
- Autopilot: picks the next step for the job you choose and runs it. It stops with the reason when a step fails twice. Tested in game on two relics of one character, both up to Zeta.
- Stage quests run through WigglyQuest with paths bundled in the plugin: A Relic Reborn, Up in Arms, Gerolt's furnace for the Zenith, His Dark Materia and the rest.
- Atma farm flies to the FATEs, syncs and fights. It skips FATEs with 2 minutes or less left.
- Trials of the Braves books: enemies, FATEs, dungeons and leves, including capture, escort and lure leves, and it unlocks the levemetes first.
- Novus: gets the sphere scroll, buys the materia from Universalis prices across your region, and infuses.
- Light and Mahatma farms through AutoDuty, Poetics through Duty Support, Alexandrite through LootGoblin maps or Allied Seals in lots of 5.
- Zodiac: the four material quests, including the HQ items they ask for at their last step, then Jalzahn's recreation and the Zeta awakening.
- Market board purchases through Lifestream on any world of your region, when "Buy from market board" is on.
- Combat plugin setting: Auto, Rotation Solver, BossMod or Wrath Combo. It applies to ZodiacHelper's own fights, AutoDuty and DAD duties, and LootGoblin's map fights.
- Gear is repaired between targets, and anything that attacks you during a non-combat step is fought back.
- Settings tab: every plugin it uses with its state and a button that copies its repository link, then the dungeon runner, combat plugin, maps, market board and repair settings. The stage tabs are inside a Manual tab, for doing each stage by hand.
Not tried in game yet: progress sharing between clients (Party tab), and DAD duties with Wrath Combo or BossMod as the combat plugin.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Anima Helper
Punchline: Heavensward Anima relic: buys, farms and turns in for you.
Description: Early beta. Takes your Anima (Heavensward) weapons through their stages: accepts the stage quests, buys the Poetics items (farming Poetics with AutoDuty when short), runs the step duties through AutoDuty and turns the quests in. Needs AutoDuty for the farms and vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Phantom Helper
Punchline: Dawntrail Phantom relic: arcanite, exchanges, Trust farms and the Occult Crescent events you still need.
Description: Early beta. Takes your Phantom weapons (Dawntrail) through their stages: buys arcanite and the one-time quest items, farms the uncapped tomestone and the Final Phantasm dungeons with Trust through AutoDuty, trades weapons at Dodokkuli, and lists the Occult Crescent FATEs and critical encounters that drop the demiatma, dispellers and crystal paste you still need. Needs AutoDuty for the farms and vnavmesh for walking.
